Hanno is a town of greenery and clear streams. Long ago, logs cut from these mountains were lashed into rafts and floated all the way to Edo and Tokyo for use as timber.

【What to bring】Drinking water, rain gear, ground cloth (picnic mat), trekking poles (optional)
